script:
onRoleReachedMoon = function() 
    game.pauseLogic()
	if global.getBool("lvl27_b1") then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		repeat
			sound.play("58-1")
		    if dialog.show("Level27-1", faceShengqi) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level27-2", faceShijin) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level27-3", faceRenzhen) ==1 then break end
			sound.play("61-2")
			if dialog.show("Level27-4", faceWunai) ==1 then break end
		    if dialog.show("Level27-5", faceBujie) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level27-6", faceWeixiao) ==1 then break end
		    if dialog.show("Level27-7", faceZhoumei) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level27-8", faceWeixiao) ==1 then break end
			global.setBool("lvl27_b1")
		until true
		dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
    game.success()
end
